meta.positional_key_note: cell_complete.json.gz keys several dicts (ppm, abund, coexpr, codep, gene2cplx, model4, cellcycle, drugs, generxn, emask, darkfn) by the gene's INDEX in `genes`, not by symbol. `cell_index` maps those keys to entity ids. Looking them up by symbol returns None for every gene and is the bug that silently zeroed an abundance control.
